concept: Reviewed archive labels, leakage grouping, and targeted source detection
baseline_artifacts: Immutable. Candidate results use a separate directory and an explicit binary hash.
labels: Verify reviewed source hashes. Distinguish behavior, activation, missing stages, and intent. Keep all other records unreviewed.
grouping: Use reviewed source anchors and metadata for leakage groups. Do not infer a campaign or propagate labels from group membership.
validation: The 400-case pilot and two added wiper versions are development evidence. The reserved set remains unopened. Its independence is provisional.
controls: Use the 28 pinned legitimate controls and paired synthetic controls. Review every newly triggered rule in the existing popular-package corpus.
safety: Read archived source as data. Never install or execute archived code, invoke lifecycle scripts, or contact embedded destinations.
measurements: Preserve baseline and candidate binaries. Alternate runs on identical fixtures. Report source timing and peak RSS, coverage, and operational install cost.
